question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Burial ground consisting of graves.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cemetery.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **"Cemetery" **is a burial ground or a place where the remains of deceased people are buried or otherwise interred. (कब्रिस्तान)

 
 
• **For example,** "Every year, they would visit the cemetery to pay respects to their ancestors."
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cemetery.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Courtyard"** is an open space that might be found in the center of a building complex. (आँगन)

 
 
• **For example,** "The children played in the sunny courtyard after school."
 
 
 
• **"Sanctuary" **denotes a safe or holy place. (अभयारण्य)
 
 
• **For example, **"The old church was a sanctuary for those seeking peace."
 
 
 
• **"Auditorium" **is a venue for events involving an audience (सभागार).
 
 
• **For example, **"The school's auditorium was packed for the annual talent show."
